title: Treat cv-ats as the only CV: do not build a designed CV (CV-A) and do not delete the unrendered cv / cv-short surfaces
body: Decided by the author 2026-10-29: `cv-ats` is the only CV, rendered by src/pages/cv.astro and src/pages/en/cv.astro and printed to the PDF. The designed CV-A (two columns, photo, colour, meant for WhatsApp/email/freelance clients) was dropped: one artifact means never wondering which one to send, and the WhatsApp/email reader gets the same PDF or the landing link. The `cv` and `cv-short` values of `Surface` in content/schema/content-schema.ts, and their rows in PRIORITY_CUTOFF / MAX_ACHIEVEMENTS_PER_ROLE in content/schema/resolve-view.ts, stay on purpose even though nothing renders them: removing them is a migration with no reader. Do not add a page, component or PDF for them, and do not prune them as dead code. The schema comment on `cv` still says "2 pages, designed": that describes the abandoned plan, not a pending task.
not_derivable: The code shows cv and cv-short as live Surface values with cutoffs; nothing says they are intentionally dead, nor that a designed CV was considered and rejected.

evidence.summary: Surface union still lists "cv" (designed, 2 pages) and "cv-short"; no page renders them.
PRIORITY_CUTOFF and MAX_ACHIEVEMENTS_PER_ROLE keep entries for cv and cv-short.
Author decision 2026-10-29: CV-A dropped, cv-ats is the only CV, cv/cv-short kept unrendered in the schema.
